_meta.description: BM25 sparse index over every reasoner's policy corpus. Shared by all reasoners; documents are tenant-filtered at query time by the reasoner_id keyword field.
_meta.analyzer_strategy: DR-13: text uses dual-analyzer multi-fields. text (english analyzer) handles natural language queries with stemming. text.keyword_search (standard analyzer) handles exact identifiers such as section numbers, control ids, or policy ids (e.g., 3.2.1, CTRL-7, POLICY-A-v2.1). Retriever must query both fields. See docs/design/decisions.md DR-13.
